prediction.raw: 0 I think it's wrong to lend your sister your hair brush when you have lice in your hair. Lice are highly contagious and can be spread through direct contact with an infected person's hair or personal items, such as hair brushes or combs. By lending your sister your hair brush, you would be putting her at risk of getting lice as well. It's considerate and responsible to take steps to prevent the spread of lice, such as washing and drying your hair brush and other personal items, or avoiding sharing them with others until you've been treated and are lice-free.
